karty.priklad: Achosodd y storm lawer o broblemau.
karty.priklad_cs: The storm caused a lot of problems (llawer → [l]awer as the object; problemau → [b]roblemau after o).
karty.mnemo: achos = cause, because: achosi = to be the cause.

karty.priklad: Prynwn ni docyn trên mis i grwydro Ewrop.
karty.priklad_cs: We'll buy a monthly train ticket to roam around Europe (tocyn → [d]ocyn; crwydro → [g]rwydro after i).
karty.mnemo: A CREW (CRWY-dro) of backpackers wanders all over Europe.

karty.priklad: Mae'n enwog fel lle i gynnal cystadleuaeth.
karty.priklad_cs: It's famous as a place to hold a competition (cynnal → [g]ynnal after i).
karty.mnemo: 'CAN ALL (CYNN-AL) come?' – we're holding an event on Saturday.

karty.priklad: Hoffwn i fynd i farchogaeth yn yr Alban.
karty.priklad_cs: I'd like to go horse riding in Scotland (mynd → [f]ynd; marchogaeth → [f]archogaeth after i).
karty.mnemo: march = horse, marchog = rider, knight: a knight MARCHES his horse along.

karty.priklad: Gwelon ni don anferth ar y traeth.
karty.priklad_cs: We saw a huge wave on the beach (ton → [d]on as the object).
karty.mnemo: An ANT as big as the Firth of Forth (AN-FERTH): huge!

karty.priklad_cs: Skiing holidays are very pricey (costus → [g]ostus after yn).
Rhys saw a terrifying sight (golygfa → [o]lygfa as the object; dychrynllyd → [dd]ychrynllyd after the feminine golygfa).
I like folk music (gwerin → [w]erin after the feminine cerddoriaeth).
karty.mnemo: 'GO, ERIN!' (GWER-in) – Erin dances a jig at the folk night.

extra.pozn: originally a noun (the folk, the common people); the coursebook lists it as an adjective

karty.priklad: Awn ni i wylio gêm rygbi ryngwladol yn yr Alban.
karty.priklad_cs: We'll go to watch an international rugby match in Scotland (gwylio → [w]ylio after i; rhyngwladol → [r]yngwladol after the feminine gêm).

karty.priklad: Cerddon ni ar hyd llwybr yr arfordir.
karty.priklad_cs: We walked along the coast path.
karty.mnemo: hyd = length: along the whole length.

karty.priklad: Aethon ni mas er gwaetha'r tywydd.
karty.priklad_cs: We went out despite the weather.
karty.mnemo: gwaetha = worst: in spite of the worst.

sever.priklad: Aethon ni allan er gwaetha'r tywydd.
sever.priklad_cs: We went out despite the weather.

karty.priklad: Mae hi wedi cael llond bola ar ei swydd.
karty.priklad_cs: She's fed up with her job.
karty.mnemo: llond = full, bola = belly: a bellyful of it.

karty.priklad: Dych chi wedi prynu car newydd sbon erioed?
karty.priklad_cs: Have you ever bought a brand-new car?

sever.priklad: Dach chi wedi prynu car newydd sbon erioed?
sever.priklad_cs: Have you ever bought a brand-new car?

karty.priklad: O leia, roedden nhw'n dweud 'Bore da'.

sever.priklad: O leia, roedden nhw'n deud 'Bore da'.
sever.pozn: north: deud instead of dweud (not in the coursebook)

karty.priklad: Arhoson ni bythefnos mewn parc thema yn yr Unol Daleithiau.
karty.priklad_cs: We spent a fortnight at a theme park in the United States (pythefnos → [b]ythefnos as an adverb of time).

karty.priklad: Mae'r ffilm yn ofnadwy. – Pam dych chi'n dweud hynny?
karty.priklad_cs: The film's awful. – Why do you say that?

sever.priklad: Mae'r ffilm yn ofnadwy. – Pam dach chi'n deud hynny?
sever.priklad_cs: The film's awful. – Why do you say that?
sever.pozn: north: dach instead of dych (L11), deud instead of dweud (not in the coursebook)

karty.priklad: Fel mae'n digwydd, dw i'n mynd i Nant Gwrtheyrn yfory.
karty.priklad_cs: As it happens, I'm going to Nant Gwrtheyrn tomorrow.
karty.mnemo: digwydd = to happen, as in digwyddiad (event).

karty.priklad: Torrodd calon Rhys. Am stori drist!
karty.priklad_cs: Rhys's heart broke. What a sad story! (trist → [d]rist after the feminine stori)

extra.pozn: exclamatory am = what a…!, followed by soft mutation (am ddiwrnod braf!)
